# CLAUDE.md

**Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md). It is the only source of truth for how
to work in this repository, and this file exists only to say so.**

Everything an agent needs is there or is pointed at from there: the
standing rules, which document owns what, the toolchain and when it is
actually needed, how to drive the machine, and the traps this project
has already paid for.

## Do not edit this file

**If something here is wrong or missing, the fix belongs in
`AGENTS.md`.** Two files describing how to work are two files that
drift, and the one nobody is looking at wins the argument at exactly
the wrong moment. This repository has been bitten by that shape more
than once — thirteen copies of `check()`, a documented `m.trace()` that
existed on neither machine, a toolchain section that said "everything
needs OSS CAD Suite" and cost a session of unnecessary hardware builds.
A second rulebook is the same mistake with better intentions.

So this file has no rules in it, and should never acquire any. If you
find yourself adding a fact here, that is the signal it belongs in
`AGENTS.md`.

## The three things most likely to be got wrong

Not rules — pointers at the sections of `AGENTS.md` that this project
has lost the most time to. Read them there, not here.

- **Every investigation goes through the harness.** Not a throwaway
  script, not `python -c`, not re-running the suite and reading the
  source until the answer appears. `sim/harness.py` and the Machine
  API, and extend them when they fall short.
- **The VM is the default for anything about software.** The hardware
  toolchain is for hardware questions and is otherwise a slow detour.
- **`docs/` is where findings live.** A measurement, a decision or a
  constraint goes into the relevant document — not into this file, not
  into `AGENTS.md`, and not into an agent's own memory outside the
  repository, where it is invisible to review and cannot be corrected.
